name: Legal Dock
summary: A classic or Mac-style dock for Hyprland and Omarchy with a real minimize button, magnifying icons, and lock/hide/transparency controls
description:
Legal Dock is a classic or Mac-style dock for Hyprland and Omarchy with two styles you can switch between with one click: Classic (the nwg-dock-hyprland dock) or Mac (a magnifying, macOS-style dock built with Quickshell, with running apps, a right-click menu, and middle-click to pin).

It adds a menu with Small/Medium/Large icon sizes, a lock for icon order, auto-hide, full-width and transparent modes, an app drawer button, and a confirm-before-reboot button.

Mac touches include a Rubik's Cube launcher that scrambles as you open windows, a New Incognito Window option on right-click for most browsers, launch-bounce animation, and Mac-style window animations (spring-open, shrink-and-fade close, minimize-to-dock).

Hyprland has no native minimize; Legal Dock adds a real one that parks windows on a hidden workspace and restores them from the dock.

Developed by 5ive7 Development Labs. MIT licensed.
notes: Packaged and mirrored by the Omarchy Store after review (license, package contents, no install hooks or outbound network calls). Source: https://github.com/5ive7/legal-dock
